name: s81sf_bfcol_c199rr

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every pin at the face: every input in g_pin.r_* (ot_v41_kreg, incl. ze_d -> r_ze and the reset synchroniser r_rst), every output from the column's own output registers (gate2 band: 839/840 ports register-at-pin, a_ctr[13] unused; native probe 0 combinational pins). A second pin-register layer would add +1 input / +1 output edge for no structural gain; io_flop_at_pins anchors the RTL pin flops.

structural_change: S81-C199-FANOUT 10-19 (successor of s81sf_bfcol_c199rq): OT_BF_FOREP data/control fan-out partition on top of FREECLK + RSTPART v2 -- no register drives more than ~32 loads through BUF/INV (rq synth census: 828 drivers > 32, max 1,060). Kept same-edge copies (zero cycles): q-lane + BF-lane chains read their accumulators through 2 kept ONE-HOT slot copies decoded one stage earlier (slot LSB 1,060 / t_lr 267 loads), per-slice first/forward copies, FP adder/multiplier cut fields (shift amounts, distances, carries) as per-slice copies, segment-tree control copies, q-lane fp4/sub/sign copies, capture enable/select copies 24 select / 20 enable copies per macro inside OT_BF_FOREP (QZ_NS/QZ_NE params unchanged), pair-tag `both` and BF valid copies. Floorplan/pins/landing/clock as c199rq.
slot_change_request: bf_col slot 450.144x198.72 -> 432.0x216.0 (frame col_h9/col_h10 owner + MU-DIE-S81: +17.28 um per row, -18.144 um width; E-face pin pitch changes -> the front tile's facing pins re-assigned top-down)
purpose: S81-C199-FANOUT 10-19: c199rq + SAFE item 3 data fan-out partition (OT_BF_FOREP). Output cycle identity vs default column; reset release +2 (kit landing, as c199r).

job.purpose: compact199 free-clock + reset-partition + fan-out partition kit (critical ot_v41_bf_: coordinator review; no submit by lane)

benches.name: rstpart
benches.cmd: cd {SRC} && python3 tools/s81/bf_txn_bench.py --variant recut --params QZE=1,TCG=1,BXST=2,FXST=2,PINLAT=1,HCOL=1 --jobs 8 --prep {SRC}/results/rtl/s81_bf_compact_20261010/compact199_pinreg_1018/bench_5050/prep --no-default-mutants --positive-define rstpart=OT_BMUL_RSPLIT+OT_BF_TAGREP+OT_BF_TILE_FREECLK+OT_BF_RSTPART --work {RUN}/bench_rq/rstpart --only rstpart; rc=$?; cat {RUN}/bench_rq/rstpart/rstpart/run.log 2>/dev/null; exit $rc
benches.git_fallback: bf_txn_bench.py wraps its only git calls (rev-parse/status for the record) in try/except and falls back to SOURCE_COMMIT/'unknown'; --prep names the committed prepared package so the git-using prepare step never runs
